description: This file is a React component for a Theme Builder interface in the Notesnook project, allowing users to create, modify, import, export, and manage themes with various UI controls and utilities.

methods.name: exportTheme
methods.description: Exports the current theme as a JSON file and optionally downloads the code-block CSS.

methods.name: themeToJSON
methods.description: Converts a ThemeDefinition object into a JSON string, excluding the codeBlockCSS property.

methods.name: onChangeColor
methods.description: Synchronizes color input and color preview inputs when a color is changed.

methods.name: convertColor
methods.description: Converts 4-character hex color codes to full 7-character hex color codes.

methods.name: getThemeFromFormData
methods.description: Extracts and processes theme data from a form element and authors list into a flattened theme object.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case with spaces before capitalized words.

methods.name: getThemeKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a theme based on its id, version, and compatibility version.
